title: Coherent finite component comparisons for strict global Hom towers
statement: For the normalized DVR tower and coherent finite identifications in lem-coef-integral-dualizing-mapping-tower-finite-comparison, there is a component isomorphism for every object of the opposite integral constructible category, and these components satisfy the naturality square for every morphism. This is the pre-assembly component data; it does not assert a functor isomorphism.

source.place: Second proof paragraph, the three displayed derived mapping-complex comparisons, before assembly into the strict natural isomorphism.

proof.text: Realize T by a quotient-system complex Q and comparison a, using the scalar Hom model. Set eQ_n=a_n inverse followed by e_n. Precompose the transition square by a_m and cancel its isomorphism; functoriality and a_n followed by its inverse reduce the equation to he.

Use coefPairingCompactificationModels to obtain the actual pairing calculus S and compactification frame G. Apply the strict finite exceptional adjunction to Q,eQ and their proved coherence. Apply the independent compact-support scalar Hom comparison; compose it with the source scalar comparison.
Take the components of this composite natural isomorphism. Its natural-transformation naturality is precisely the displayed component naturality equation.

proof_origin.place: Second proof paragraph: finite mapping-complex comparisons and reduction-compatible counits.
proof_origin.note: Compiling decomposition into three strict substeps separated by the concrete quotient-system compact-support Hom functor. Transition transport, cancellation, composition and naturality are fully proved in Lean; three new supporting theorems remain open.

lean.statement:
theorem integralDualizing_mapping_tower_finite_components
    (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, T.M n ≅ integralDualizingFiniteTerm l E D X n)
    (he : ∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m),
      T.tau h ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X h).map (e n).hom =
        (e m).hom ≫
          (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (normalizedDVRRes l E X h)).homEquiv _ _
            (integralDualizingFiniteComparison l E D X hl h)) :
    ∃ (a : ∀ K : (sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)ᵒᵖ,
      (integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower).obj K ≅
        ((integralDualizingCompactSections l E D hl X).op ⋙
          integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E).obj K),
      ∀ {K L : (sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)ᵒᵖ} (f : K ⟶ L),
        (integralDualizingMappingTower l E X T.tower).map f ≫ (a L).hom =
          (a K).hom ≫
            ((integralDualizingCompactSections l E D hl X).op ⋙
              integralDualizingCoefficientHomTower l E).map f
